== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Damasca is a unified nation that has been ruled by a single royal bloodline for over three hundred and fifty years. The kingdom's prosperity is largely due to its control over various Territories, which allow the nation to secure its borders, import resources like food and tea, and facilitate the movement of goods and messages. The monarchy's power is tied to their unique ability to access [[Ragnarus the Crimson Vault|Ragnarus]], also known as the [[Crimson Vault]], a territory that contains potent weaponry. Access to this area is restricted to those of royal descent and requires a recurring blood sacrifice to maintain its seals. While the ruling family claims their actions, including these sacrifices, are intended to protect the world from greater violence, they are often viewed by others as tyrannical or cruel. The [[Damascan]] military is noted for its legendary status, and the kingdom has a history of conflict with entities such as [[Valinhall]] and [[Enosh]]. The current leadership includes [[King Zakareth the Sixth]], though recent events involve the death of a king and the presence of an [[Incarnation of Ragnarus]].}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Damasca is a kingdom defined by its red and gold royal colors and a three-and-a-half century reign under a tyrant king. The nation is plagued by an unnatural blight and maintains its power through the use of bloody [[Trees]] and the practice of human sacrifice. For three centuries, the kingdom has imprisoned [[Incarnations]] underground in [[chains]], where they are subjected to beatings and whipping. Following the death of [[Malachi|Overlord Malachi]], Damasca began preparing for war, utilizing its control over [[Naraka]]'s travel routes and its many [[Travelers]] to organize military actions. While [[Leah]] stands second in line for the throne, Grandmaster teams have targeted the kingdom for destruction, and leaders like [[Indirial]] work to navigate the political landscape of the [[Damascan]] war.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Originally formed into a unified nation by [[Queen]] [[Cynara]], Damasca is a young country that previously endured attacks from the [[Elysian Incarnation]]. Although [[Grandmaster Helgard]] disputes the realm's divine right to control the Territories, the nation has flourished for three and a half centuries under the rule of [[Leah]]'s family. While [[Leah]] serves as the current [[Queen]] and perceives no threat to her land, [[Zakareth]] has emerged to claim the title of King. Notably, Damasca is a location distinct from the origins of Feiora's orders.}}
